title: Brush tangles every run
body: The main brush is wrapped in hair after every single run and I have to cut it off with scissors, which takes longer than the vacuuming.

title: 太吵
body: 晚上根本不敢开，声音跟吹风机差不多，隔壁房间都听得见。

title: Does the job
body: Maps the flat properly and picks up dog hair well. Happy with it after three months.

title: Won't pair with 5GHz
body: The app refuses to pair on my 5GHz network and support only says to switch to 2.4, but my router does not allow separate bands.

title: Puddle under the dock
body: After every mop there is a puddle under the dock. The rubber seal on the tank looks warped out of the box.

title: Too tall for the sofa
body: It is about ten centimetres tall so it cannot get under the sofa or the bed, which is half of my floor.

title: 回充太慢
body: 扫二十分钟就要回去充两个小时，一百平的房子一天都跑不完。

title: Side motor died
body: The side brush motor stopped spinning after six weeks. It just drags itself in circles now.

title: Contacts run hot
body: The charging contacts get very hot and there is a faint burnt plastic smell while it is on the dock.

title: 轮子掉了
body: 用了两个月右边轮子直接掉下来，塑料卡扣断了，做工比玩具还差。

title: Fine except on max
body: Works well on the low setting, but on max power the noise is unbearable and I have to leave the room.

title: Dock does not fit
body: The dock is bigger than the vacuum and does not fit under my console table, so it sits in the middle of the hallway.

title: 缠头发
body: 滚刷缠头发很厉害，每次都要拆下来一小把一小把地清，家里有长发慎买。

title: Bags must be official
body: Only the official bags click in. The cheaper third-party ones sit loose and the dock refuses to start.

title: Bumper cracked
body: The front bumper cracked the first time it hit a chair leg. The plastic feels like a toy.

title: 值
body: 扫得干净，拖地也够用，同配置里算便宜的，推荐。

title: 水箱渗水
body: 拖完地水箱底下总有一摊水，木地板都翘起来了。

title: Dead in two months
body: It stopped charging entirely after two months, the dock light just blinks red now.

title: Mopping is a gimmick
body: The mop pad just drags a wet cloth around and smears dirt instead of lifting it.

title: Stuck under the couch
body: It wedges itself under the couch every run and I have to pull it out by the bumper.

title: 噪音大
body: 吸力一般但噪音特别大，在家开会的时候完全不敢开。

title: Good, annoying app
body: Cleaning is good, but the app logs me out every few days and I have to re-pair the robot.

title: Filter clogs daily
body: The filter is packed with fine dust after every run and washing it does not help. Replacement filters are expensive.

title: 电机异响
body: 用了一个月电机开始嗡嗡响，后来干脆不转了，只能当摆设。

title: Four hour recharge
body: It takes almost four hours to recharge, so a full house takes two days.

title: 基站太大
body: 基站太大了，阳台放不下，只能摆在客厅中间。

title: Waste of money
body: Barely picks up crumbs and the battery lasts twenty minutes. Not worth a third of what I paid.

title: Great value
body: For the price it is excellent, quiet on the low setting and the battery covers the whole flat.

title: Scratched my floor
body: Suction is great, but the front bumper has a sharp edge and left scratches on the wood floor.

title: 墙缝清不到
body: 墙角和小缝隙清不干净，最后还得自己拿吸尘器补一遍。

title: Wheel came off
body: One wheel came off in the second week and the plastic axle had snapped clean through.

title: Soaks the rug
body: The mop leaves so much water that the floor stays wet and the edge of the rug is soaked.

title: Loud rattle on tile
body: On tile the brush makes a loud rattling sound, though on carpet it is quiet enough.

title: 配网失败
body: 路由器只有 5G 频段，机器一直配网失败，客服让我换个路由器。

title: Never woke up
body: Left it on the dock for a week while I was away and it never turned on again.

title: Bin fills fast
body: The dust bin is small, I have to empty it after every room.

title: 不值这个价
body: 功能跟三百块的差不多，卖这么贵不值。

title: 满意
body: 扫拖一体够用，噪音比想象中小，家里老人也会用。

title: Hot battery
body: The battery compartment gets warm enough that I unplug the dock at night.

title: Battery life short
body: Twenty minutes of cleaning then it goes back for three hours, so the house is never finished.

title: Average suction
body: Average. Suction is weaker than my old upright and for the price I expected more.

title: 配件买不到
body: 滚刷磨完以后官方配件一直缺货，第三方又装不上，机器就废了。
